---
title: "University of Helsinki visiting fellowship"
date: 2026-09-14
description: "Derek Van Berkel is spending part of 2026 at the University of Helsinki through the North America Visiting Fellowship."
categories: [People, Collaboration]
---

Derek Van Berkel is a 2026 North America Visiting Fellow at the University of Helsinki, hosted by Prof. Enrico Di Minin. The visit supports collaboration around geospatial data science, artificial intelligence, conservation, and human–environment research.
